note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants, and one chant-book reading. The Missal and the digital witness agree on the substantive text; the Liber Usualis antiphon sets nuntiáte at w007, recorded below.

adjudicated.ruling: The approved Benziger printing's spelling is retained under the house orthography. The witness reading is the same word in another editorial spelling.

The approved Benziger printing (p. 339) and the digital witness repeat annuntiáte; the chant book sets the simple verb nuntiáte here (p. 830). The edition follows the Missal and records the chant-book reading without adopting it.
The chant book prints the digraph ae and marks the singing accent (térrae:); the approved Benziger printing prints terræ: with the ligature, and the edition follows the Missal.
